newsitem.title: USA: Horace Mann to exit from medical insurance.
newsitem.headline: Horace Mann to exit from medical insurance.

text.p: Horace Mann Educators Corp said Monday it plans to withdraw from the group medical insurance business over the next two years to focus on its group life and disability insurance lines.

The company will account for group medical as a discontinued operation and expects to incur a $3 million charge in the 1996 fourth quarter for severance and other expenses and for operating losses during the phase-out period.
Horace Mann estimated it will realize an after-tax net operating loss of $5 million in fiscal 1996 from its group medical insurance line.
Withdrawal from group medical will result in elimination of about 40 jobs over 1997 and 1998, it noted.
The company said it intends to stop writing new group medical insurance policies in January 1997 and stop renewing group medical insurance policies in January 1998.
Horace Mann said its group medical business for the year ended December 31, 1995 generated 6.8 percent of the company's total premiums written and contract deposits.
